title: The classes of 'same remainder mod 3'
caption: The three classes {3, 6}, {1, 4} and {2, 5} do not overlap and together contain all six elements: an equivalence relation splits the set into a partition.
alt: Three separate groups of elements with no overlap: {3, 6}, {1, 4} and {2, 5}.
description: Sort 1 to 6 by remainder on division by 3.
Remainder 0 gives {3, 6}, remainder 1 gives {1, 4}, remainder 2 gives {2, 5}.
No element is in two classes, and every element is in one.
So the classes partition the set.

checks.name: the three classes hold all 6 elements
